_doc: One business's cold email settings. Names of things only: no key, no list, no person. The charter block and each campaign's audience and sequence come from the owner.

targets._doc: Both are counted per person contacted, not per email sent.

pause_at._doc: The daily read says PAUSE for a campaign at or over this. Not the owner's number: see STATUS.md.

charter.who: Partners only (Justin, 2026-11-24: "cold email through partnerships, for partnerships, but not for direct leads, at least not for right now"): people who already have business owners gathered around them
charter._doc: The owner's charter: who to prospect, how, and what a first line may say. Pasted in the owner's words.

list.source: the worker's local-places and research lanes, verified with the pack's email verifier (skills/verify-emails)

first_lines.fallback: I came across {company} while looking at {industry} businesses in {city}.
first_lines._doc: model: the exact id the Codex CLI lists for the model the owner named; blank uses the CLI's own default. fallback: the line a row gets when the engine gives none; it uses columns the list has.

local-businesses.audience: owners of local businesses in the week's metro

_waits: daily_sends is 0 until the domain decision and the owner's charter; plan shows what any number needs. Research-intent lists are email only, never text or call, and only after the owner approves the sender, the copy and the postal address (context/01-lead-sources.md).
